findings.summary: The exact decoded certificate contains 152 distinct points in G_76, and the exhaustive verifier checks all 573,800 unordered triples using the exact determinant criterion, certifying that no three points are collinear.
The certified 152-point configuration proves D(76) >= 152, while the horizontal-line capacity bound gives D(76) <= 152; hence the supplied evidence entails D(76) = 152.
Because G_76 is contained in G_77 and the embedding preserves incidences, the same certified 152 points prove D(77) >= 152.
Every no-three-in-line subset of G_77 has at most two points on each of its 77 horizontal lines, proving D(77) <= 154. This restates the baseline upper bound rather than improving it.
If a 154-point configuration in G_77 exists, the row and column capacity counts force every row and every column to contain exactly two selected points.

For any hypothetical 153-point configuration in G_77, exactly one row must contain one selected point and every other row two; independently, exactly one column must contain one selected point and every other column two.
Combining the embedded 152-point certificate with the elementary row bound certifies 152 <= D(77) <= 154.
The contribution does not distinguish D(77) = 152, 153, or 154: it supplies neither a 153- or 154-point certificate nor an impossibility or exhaustive-search certificate excluding either value.

The initial marker is recognized but ignored by the verifier, so the transaction does not independently certify that the decoded G_76 configuration has quarter-turn symmetry; this does not affect the no-three-in-line or lower-bound conclusions.
